name: Himawari!! -Anata Dake o Mitsumeteru-
original_name: ひまわり!! -あなただけを見つめてる-
source:
You could spend your summer vacation only sleeping and doing your homework, but don't you want to do something more? How about a boisterous time in swimsuits or throwing a pajama party? We could gaze at the full moon and make the sweetest love. Let's have the best summer vacation ever!

This chara-ge is set in the small rural town of Himukai-chou where Ryouta is part of the "Himawari Club". While "himawari" means "sunflower", it might as well the "Hima-ari (have free time) club" as they just do random stuff.

Sweetlight is using the E-mote system to add more animation to the game. It makes you feel like you're enjoying the summer with the girls. Even the H-scenes are fully animated, with lots of facial expression changes.

[Edited from [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/08/01/august-2014-eroge-releases//]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
你可以在暑假里只睡觉和做作业，但你不想做更多的事情吗？穿着泳衣享受热闹时光或举办睡衣派对怎么样？我们可以凝望满月，做最甜蜜的爱。让我们度过一个最美好的暑假吧！

这个角色的故事发生在Himukai-chou的一个乡村小镇，Ryouta是“Himawari Club”的成员。虽然“himawari”的意思是“向日葵”，但它可能就像“Hima-ari（有空闲时间）俱乐部”一样，因为他们只是做随机的事情。

Sweetlight正在使用E-mote系统为游戏添加更多动画。这让你感觉你正在和女孩们一起享受夏天。即使是H场景也是完全动画化的，有很多面部表情的变化。

[编辑自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/08/01/august-2014-eroge-releases//]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
